mentions.name: Multicoder
mentions.description: Multicoder is a VS Code extension providing a single GUI for launching and working with any ACP-compatible coding agent, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Qwen. It requires no new subscription or user ID since authentication is handled by the agent harness, letting users work with their existing subscriptions in one UI without mental switching cost.
mentions.problem: Working with multiple coding agents means switching between different harnesses, incurring a mental switching cost; Multicoder provides one high-quality UI for all of them.
mentions.audience: Working developers who use AI coding agents
mentions.source_excerpt: One UI for every coding agent - VS Code extension (GUI) to launch and work with any ACP-compatible agent harness. Supports Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Qwen and many others
